messages.subject: Your November rota
messages.body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for signing up for more shifts in November! Here's your rota:

1. Sat 7 Nov, 09:00-12:00 - Pantry intake desk, main hall at Northfield Community Centre
2. Wed 11 Nov, 17:30-20:00 - Mobile pantry van, Eastgate estate (meet at the van by the library car park)
3. Sat 14 Nov, 10:00-13:00 - School food drive collection, Riverside Primary School
4. Sun 22 Nov, 10:00-12:30 - Gleaning at Hollins Lane allotments (bring gloves)
5. Sat 28 Nov, 13:00-17:00 - Holiday hamper packing, St Bride's church hall

Let me know if any of these don't work.

Gwen
